Best Man Speech Generator

Build a best man speech outline — opening, anecdotes, jokes, heartfelt middle, and toast — personalized with names.

Your speech outline will appear here.

An outline to rehearse from — add your own stories so it sounds like you.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter names and a funny memory.
  2. Pick the jokes and tone you like.
  3. Generate your outline, then copy or download.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do I need to enter?

Your name, the groom's name, the partner's name, a funny memory, and how you know the groom — the tool builds a full outline.

What sections are included?

Opening, funny story, heartfelt story, jokes, advice, and the toast — in classic speech order.

What tones are available?

Funny, Heartfelt, or Short & Sweet — pick the vibe for your speech.

How do I save it?

Copy it or download as a .txt file to rehearse.
